group.title: New loading-dock arrangements
group.passage: Attention, delivery drivers. Starting next week, trucks carrying electronic components must use Dock Four instead of Dock Two. Dock Two will be reserved for outgoing finished products. The new arrangement is intended to keep incoming and outgoing shipments from blocking each other. Please book an arrival window through the logistics portal before leaving your warehouse. Drivers arriving more than thirty minutes early should wait in the holding area outside the east gate. The receiving team will scan the advance shipping notice at the dock, so keep a printed copy or the digital code ready.
group.passageZh: 請送貨司機注意。從下週開始，運送電子零件的貨車必須改用四號裝卸區，不再使用二號。二號裝卸區將保留給出貨成品。新安排是為了避免進貨與出貨互相阻塞。請在離開倉庫前，先透過物流入口網站預約抵達時段。比預約時間早到超過三十分鐘的司機，請在東門外的等候區等待。收貨團隊會在裝卸區掃描預先出貨通知，請準備好紙本或電子代碼。
